final_rationale: The Actor did not provide genuinely new admissible evidence. The response mainly reframed the same record into a narrower and more policy-bounded position: certification would be supportable only with explicit disclosure of the unresolved limitation. That clarification is analytically sound, but it does not satisfy the missing compliance predicate on the present record. The policy text requires either no remaining material weakness or an approved mitigation for certification without caveats, and it also requires disclosure of material limitations unless resolved or covered by approved risk acceptance. The available evidence still shows an unresolved below-target fraud-dispute-review slice, an incomplete draft runbook, and a draft model card saying there are no known material limitations. Because there is still no admissible evidence that the final certification materials were actually updated to disclose the limitation, the record does not yet support moving from suspicious to compliant_with_caveats. This is a case where the caveated position could become compliant_with_caveats if documented, but that future condition is not itself proved by the current evidence.
